assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument contains a dedicated module titled 'K. OTRAS FORMAS DE TRABAJO (TRABAJO SIN REMUNERACIÓN EN PRODUCCIÓN DE SERVICIOS)', which is separate from the primary labor force modules (Chapters H, I, and J). This module includes six distinct questions measuring unpaid domestic and care work activities: cooking/washing dishes, laundry, house cleaning/maintenance, childcare for children under 5, care for sick/disabled/elderly individuals, and assistance with schoolwork. Because this module includes six questions, it satisfies the requirement of containing more than two questions.
